Backend Engineer — Nimbus Freight (YC S24)

We're a Y Combinator-backed logistics startup building real-time freight
tracking infrastructure for mid-size carriers.

Requirements:
- 3+ years of experience building production backend services
- Strong experience with React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment

Nice to have:
- Experience with Docker and AWS

How to apply:
Please apply through our careers page at https://nimbusfreight.example/careers.
Do not email us directly — applications sent by email will not be reviewed.
